payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, including its performance compared to other models and its efficiency in processing data.

claims.text: NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with a favorable generalization ability across multiple datasets.
NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1 compared to other global models.
The NCEL approach is efficient for large-scale data due to its unique application of GCN and batch techniques.
